positions.title: Data / Risk Analyst (Merchant Risk)
positions.description: Owned data pipelines and analytics for Merchant Risk on India's largest payments platform. Designed scalable SQL/Python pipelines, shipped 150+ Looker reports, and embedded risk-detection logic directly into the payment flow.
achievements: Designed scalable data pipelines in SQL and Python to aggregate and normalize transactional, merchant and behavioral data for real-time risk analysis — reducing manual review dependency by 60%.
Built and maintained 150+ Looker reports for sales and ops teams over a year, directly enabling 200+ sales POCs across multiple hierarchy levels.
Drove deep-impact analytics during a 350% YoY business surge, including lead scoring, CLTV modeling and marketing analytics.
Partnered with engineering and product to integrate risk-detection logic into the payment processing flow, reducing fraud attempts and unauthorized usage by 25%.
Investigated merchant-level (MID) risk cases involving abnormal volume surges, policy violations and compliance breaches, and recommended account-level actions (hold, KYC review, blacklisting).

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern
positions.description: Worked on financial-data ML projects end to end — from EDA on large datasets to deploying real-time prediction services and dashboards.
achievements: Performed exploratory data analysis on large financial datasets to surface trends, anomalies and risk indicators using pandas, NumPy and seaborn.
Built and tuned predictive models (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, ANN) for credit risk classification and fraud detection, with feature engineering and cross-validation to lift accuracy.
Deployed ML models on Heroku via Flask and Streamlit, enabling real-time predictions and interactive dashboards for end users in a financial analytics context.
